# link

Link API
- API version: 1.0
  - Generator version: 7.24.0

Servicios de consulta y validación de kiban (CURP, SAT, IMSS, Buró, etc.) y administración de credenciales. En sandbox (sandbox.link.kiban.com) las ejecuciones responden test cases en lugar de llamar al proveedor.

  For more information, please visit [https://kiban.com](https://kiban.com)

*Automatically generated by the [OpenAPI Generator](https://openapi-generator.tech)*


## Requirements

Building the API client library requires:
1. Java 1.8+
2. Maven (3.8.3+)/Gradle (7.2+)

## Installation

To install the API client library to your local Maven repository, simply execute:

```shell
mvn clean install
```

To deploy it to a remote Maven repository instead, configure the settings of the repository and execute:

```shell
mvn clean deploy
```

Refer to the [OSSRH Guide](http://central.sonatype.org/pages/ossrh-guide.html) for more information.

### Maven users

Add this dependency to your project's POM:

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>com.kiban</groupId>
  <artifactId>link</artifactId>
  <version>1.0.0</version>
  <scope>compile</scope>
</dependency>
```

### Gradle users

Add this dependency to your project's build file:

```groovy
  repositories {
    mavenCentral()     // Needed if the 'link' jar has been published to maven central.
    mavenLocal()       // Needed if the 'link' jar has been published to the local maven repo.
  }

  dependencies {
     implementation "com.kiban:link:1.0.0"
  }
```

### Others

At first generate the JAR by executing:

```shell
mvn clean package
```

Then manually install the following JARs:

* `target/link-1.0.0.jar`
* `target/lib/*.jar`

## Getting Started

Please follow the [installation](#installation) instruction and execute the following Java code:

```java

// Import classes:
import com.kiban.link.ApiClient;
import com.kiban.link.ApiException;
import com.kiban.link.Configuration;
import com.kiban.link.auth.*;
import com.kiban.link.model.*;
import com.kiban.link.api.LinkApi;

public class Example {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    ApiClient defaultClient = Configuration.getDefaultApiClient();
    defaultClient.setBasePath("https://link.kiban.com");
    
    // Configure API key authorization: ApiKeyAuth
    ApiKeyAuth ApiKeyAuth = (ApiKeyAuth) defaultClient.getAuthentication("ApiKeyAuth");
    ApiKeyAuth.setApiKey("YOUR API KEY");
    // Uncomment the following line to set a prefix for the API key, e.g. "Token" (defaults to null)
    //ApiKeyAuth.setApiKeyPrefix("Token");

    LinkApi apiInstance = new LinkApi(defaultClient);
    String service = "service_example"; // String | Servicio del catálogo (p. ej. curp, sat, imss, bc_pf)
    String subservice = "subservice_example"; // String | Operación del servicio (p. ej. validate, query)
    Object body = null; // Object | Datos del servicio; cada servicio define sus campos
    Boolean sandbox = true; // Boolean | Modo sandbox. Tiene que coincidir con el modo de la API key: una key de sandbox exige sandbox=true y una de producción no lo acepta. Se ignora en el host sandbox, donde ya es implícito
    String testCase = "testCase_example"; // String | Sandbox: nombre del test case que debe responder
    String testCaseId = "testCaseId_example"; // String | Sandbox: id del test case que debe responder
    String origin = "origin_example"; // String | Identificador libre del origen de la petición
    try {
      ControllerMicroserviceModelMicroserviceDetailDto result = apiInstance.executeService(service, subservice, body)
            .sandbox(sandbox)
            .testCase(testCase)
            .testCaseId(testCaseId)
            .origin(origin)
            .execute();
      System.out.println(result);
    } catch (ApiException e) {
      System.err.println("Exception when calling LinkApi#executeService");
      System.err.println("Status code: " + e.getCode());
      System.err.println("Reason: " + e.getResponseBody());
      System.err.println("Response headers: " + e.getResponseHeaders());
      e.printStackTrace();
    }
  }
}

```
